CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 31
   C. 43
   D. 41

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

3. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

4. Solve for x: x + 5 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 15
   D. 5

5. Solve for x: x + 9 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 9
   D. 17

6. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

8. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 1

9. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

10. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 6

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

12. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

13. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 12
   C. 2
   D. 14

14. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 144

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

18. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

19. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 2

20. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

21. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 8
   D. 16

22. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

23. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 3

24. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 1
